    L

    launch(Class, String[]) - Static method in class be.imgn.swing.ui.Swing
    Launches an application, in these steps: on the main thread, reads the descriptor of the application class; on macOS, sets apple.awt.application.name to its name and apple.laf.useScreenMenuBar to true; on the main thread, builds the root injector, which binds ApplicationInfo, Arguments, DisplayLocale and the application Scope; on the main thread, runs every StartupStep, sorted by order then by class name; on the EDT, installs the look and feel, checks the icons, creates the main window and shows it; on the EDT, once the events posted while showing the window have run, calls the main view's SingleFrame.ready(), then every ReadyListener.
    Lifecycle - Interface in be.imgn.swing
    Requests the shutdown of the application.
